page.overview:
Who is Blaino?

In , becomes a regular character capable of speech. He lives within his boxing gym in , and will challenge to a boxing match for 10 . The mini-game is won by knocking him out of the ring (or lost by getting knocked out of the ring) using only fists, as items (or rings) are not allowed. If attempts to use an item during the minigame, the match will automatically end. As punishment, will raise the price of a match to 20 . The prize for defeating is 30 .

On his adventures, must win back by defeating in a boxing match. The gloves belong to , who lost to in a boxing match, consequently losing his gloves to the boxing champion.
